title: Checkout and Functions
meta: Custom discounts, shipping and payment rules and checkout blocks built with Shopify Functions. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shopify checkout extensions and Functions, built to your rules
overview: Shopify Functions let your store apply custom logic at checkout without slowing it down, and checkout extensions add your own blocks to the page. We build rules such as volume discounts, hiding a payment method for certain carts, custom shipping rates or a gift message field. Each function is tested with realistic cart examples and deployed through an app on your store.

faq: Some checkout customizations need Plus, others work on any plan. Functions for discounts, delivery and payment customization depend on your plan and the app type. We confirm what fits your store before you order.
Can you replace my old checkout scripts?
Yes. Shopify has retired checkout.liquid and the Script Editor. We read what your scripts do and rebuild the logic with Functions and checkout extensions, as far as the platform allows.
What kinds of rules can a Function handle?
Discounts on carts and products, delivery option names and prices, payment method hiding and ordering, and cart validation. We list what your rule needs and confirm the right Function type.
No. Functions run on Shopify's own servers in milliseconds and have strict limits. We keep the logic small and test it with carts of different sizes to stay inside those limits.
